figures.alt: Free-standing pressure-treated pergola on concrete piers beside a Florida paver patio
figures.caption: A pergola starts with its support plan: post locations, pier or footing strategy, property setbacks, and wind exposure should be sorted out before the framing goes up.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Pergola double beams connected to a wood post with clean black structural hardware
figures.caption: Straight beams and repeatable connections make the layout easier to inspect. Hardware and fastener choices should suit the framing and the conditions at the site rather than just look substantial.

figures.alt: Galvanized exterior anchor bracket securing a small wood structure to a concrete slab
figures.caption: Jacksonville weather adds wind and rain to the planning. Outdoor structures need a support and connection strategy that stays reliable after ordinary summer storms, not only on a dry installation day.
